key_insight: GraphEP turns cardiac simulations into graph-native learning data, with physiology-informed models leading on complementary prediction metrics.
engineering_relevance: The system provides a reproducible foundation for learning cardiac electrical dynamics on irregular anatomical meshes.
method: Package geometry, tissue properties, stimulation, connectivity, activation targets, and provenance in PyTorch Geometric format.
Benchmark local message passing, global neural operators, hierarchical graph transformers, and physiology-informed models.
Model activation timing separately with HGT-Lag or evolve excitation and recovery autoregressively with GAP2ODE.
evidence_signal: The benchmark includes 732 left-ventricular simulations across 20 anatomies, spanning healthy and scarred tissue and multiple pacing configurations.
watch_item: The abstract does not establish generalization from simulated left-ventricular data to experimental or clinical recordings.
paper_title: GraphEP: A Calibrated Data System and Benchmark for Learning Cardiac Electrophysiology
